intro.en: A daughter asks her mother about the two Eids in Islam: when they come, and what we do. We also learn about Zakat al-Fitr, which is given to the poor.
intro.ur: Ek beti apni ammi se Islam ki do Eidon ke bare mein poochti hai: woh kab aati hain aur hum kya karte hain. Hum Zakat al-Fitr ke bare mein bhi seekhte hain jo gareebon ko di jati hai.
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ بِنْتٌ أُمَّها عَنِ العيدَيْنِ في الإِسْلامِ: مَتى يَأْتِيانِ وَماذا نَفْعَلُ فيهِما. وَنَتَعَلَّمُ أَيْضًا عَنْ زَكاةِ الفِطْرِ الَّتي تُعْطى لِلْفُقَراءِ.

dialogue.ar: يا أُمّي، كَمْ عيداً عِنْدَنا نَحْنُ المُسْلِمينَ؟
dialogue.tr: yā ummī, kam ʿīdan ʿindanā naḥnu l-muslimīn?
dialogue.en: Mother, how many Eids do we Muslims have?
dialogue.ur: Ammi, hum Musalmanon ki kitni Eidein hain?

dialogue.ar: الأَوَّلُ عيدُ الفِطْرِ، وَالثّاني عيدُ الأَضْحى، وَهُما فَرَحٌ لِلْجَميعِ.
dialogue.tr: al-awwalu ʿīdu l-fiṭr, wa th-thānī ʿīdu l-aḍḥā, wa humā faraḥun lil-jamīʿ
dialogue.en: The first is Eid al-Fitr and the second is Eid al-Adha, and both are joy for everyone.
dialogue.ur: Pehli Eid-ul-Fitr hai aur doosri Eid-ul-Adha, aur donon sab ke liye khushi hain.

dialogue.ar: مَتى يَأْتي عيدُ الفِطْرِ؟
dialogue.tr: matā yaʾtī ʿīdu l-fiṭr?
dialogue.en: When does Eid al-Fitr come?
dialogue.ur: Eid-ul-Fitr kab aati hai?

dialogue.ar: يَأْتي في اليَوْمِ الأَوَّلِ مِنْ شَهْرِ شَوّالٍ، بَعْدَ رَمَضانَ.
dialogue.tr: yaʾtī fī l-yawmi l-awwali min shahri Shawwāl, baʿda Ramaḍān
dialogue.en: It comes on the first day of the month of Shawwal, after Ramadan.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Shawwal ke mahine ke pehle din aati hai, Ramazan ke baad.

dialogue.ar: أَخْبِريني يا أُمّي، ما هِيَ زَكاةُ الفِطْرِ؟
dialogue.tr: akhbirīnī yā ummī, mā hiya zakātu l-fiṭr?
dialogue.en: Tell me, mother, what is Zakat al-Fitr?
dialogue.ur: Ammi, mujhe batayein, Zakat al-Fitr kya hai?

dialogue.ar: هِيَ صاعٌ مِنَ الطَّعامِ نُعْطيهِ لِلْفُقَراءِ عَنْ كُلِّ شَخْصٍ.
dialogue.tr: hiya ṣāʿun mina ṭ-ṭaʿām nuʿṭīhi lil-fuqarāʾi ʿan kulli shakhṣ
dialogue.en: It is a saa' of food that we give to the poor for each person.
dialogue.ur: Yeh ek saa khana hai jo hum har shakhs ki taraf se gareebon ko dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَما أَوَّلُ ما نَفْعَلُهُ صَباحَ العيدِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mā awwalu mā nafʿaluhu ṣabāḥa l-ʿīd?
dialogue.en: And what is the first thing we do on Eid morning?
dialogue.ur: Aur Eid ki subah sab se pehle hum kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: نَخْرُجُ لِصَلاةِ العيدِ مَعَ النّاسِ، وَبَعْدَها نَزورُ جَدَّتي وَالأَهْلَ.
dialogue.tr: nakhruju li-ṣalāti l-ʿīdi maʿa n-nās, wa baʿdahā nazūru jaddatī wa l-ahl
dialogue.en: We go out for the Eid prayer with the people, and afterwards we visit grandmother and the family.
dialogue.ur: Hum logon ke saath Eid ki namaz ke liye nikalte hain, aur uske baad nani/dadi aur rishtedaron se milte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمَتى يَكونُ عيدُ الأَضْحى؟
dialogue.tr: wa matā yakūnu ʿīdu l-aḍḥā?
dialogue.en: And when is Eid al-Adha?
dialogue.ur: Aur Eid-ul-Adha kab hoti hai?

dialogue.ar: هُوَ في شَهْرِ ذي الحِجَّةِ، في يَوْمِهِ العاشِرِ.
dialogue.tr: huwa fī shahri dhī l-ḥijja, fī yawmihi l-ʿāshir
dialogue.en: It is in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, on its tenth day.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Dhul-Hijjah ke mahine mein, uske daswein din hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما الَّذي نَعْمَلُهُ في هَذا العيدِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mā lladhī naʿmaluhu fī hādhā l-ʿīd?
dialogue.en: And what do we do on this Eid?
dialogue.ur: Aur is Eid par hum kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ الصَّلاةِ نَذْبَحُ الأُضْحِيَّةَ، وَنَفْرَحُ مَعَ الأَهْلِ.
dialogue.tr: baʿda ṣ-ṣalāti nadhbaḥu l-uḍḥiyya, wa nafraḥu maʿa l-ahl
dialogue.en: After the prayer we sacrifice the animal, and we rejoice with the family.
dialogue.ur: Namaz ke baad hum qurbani karte hain, aur ghar walon ke saath khushi manate hain.

dialogue.ar: ما أَجْمَلَ العيدَيْنِ يا أُمّي!
dialogue.tr: mā ajmala l-ʿīdayni yā ummī!
dialogue.en: How beautiful the two Eids are, mother!
dialogue.ur: Ammi, dono Eidein kitni khoobsurat hain!

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ يا حَبيبَتي، كُلُّ عامٍ وَأَنْتِ بِخَيْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam yā ḥabībatī, kullu ʿāmin wa anti bi-khayr
dialogue.en: Yes, my dear. May you be well every year.
dialogue.ur: Haan meri pyari, har saal aap khair se rahein.

q.en: How many Eids are there in Islam?

options: في اليَوْمِ العاشِرِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّة
صاعٌ مِنْ طَعامٍ عَنْ كُلِّ شَخْص

q.ur: Zakat-ul-Fitr kis ko di jati hai?

options: في اليَوْمِ العاشِرِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّة

intro.en: Sultan, his sister Hanan and their mother talk about a holiday trip to Jordan. They choose how to travel, by air or by sea, and how many days to stay.
intro.ur: Sultan, uski behan Hanan aur unki ammi chhutti mein Urdun ke safar ke bare mein baat karte hain. Woh tay karte hain ke kaise jayein, hawa ke raaste ya samundar ke raaste, aur kitne din thehrein.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ سُلْطانُ وَأُخْتُهُ حَنانُ وَأُمُّهُما عَنْ رِحْلَةِ العُطْلَةِ إِلى الأُرْدُنِّ. يَخْتارونَ طَريقَةَ السَّفَرِ، بِالجَوِّ أَوْ بِالبَحْرِ، وَعَدَدَ الأَيّامِ.

dialogue.ar: يا أُمّي، العُطْلَةُ تَقْتَرِبُ، فَإِلى أَيْنَ نُسافِرُ هَذِهِ المَرَّةَ؟
dialogue.tr: yā ummī, l-ʿuṭlatu taqtarib, fa-ilā ayna nusāfiru hādhihi l-marra?
dialogue.en: Mother, the holiday is near. Where shall we travel this time?
dialogue.ur: Ammi, chhutti qareeb aa rahi hai, is baar hum kahan safar karein?

dialogue.ar: يا حَنانُ، هَلْ عِنْدَكِ فِكْرَةٌ؟
dialogue.tr: yā Ḥanān, hal ʿindaki fikra?
dialogue.en: Hanan, do you have an idea?
dialogue.ur: Hanan, kya aapke paas koi khayal hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ يا أُمّي، فِكْرَتي أَنْ نُسافِرَ إِلى الأُرْدُنِّ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam yā ummī, fikratī an nusāfira ilā l-Urdunn
dialogue.en: Yes, mother, my idea is that we travel to Jordan.
dialogue.ur: Ji ammi, mera khayal hai ke hum Urdun jayein.

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا الأُرْدُنُّ يا حَنانُ؟
dialogue.tr: wa limādhā l-Urdunnu yā Ḥanān?
dialogue.en: And why Jordan, Hanan?
dialogue.ur: Aur Urdun hi kyun, Hanan?

dialogue.ar: لِنَرى نَهْرَ الأُرْدُنِّ وَالبَحْرَ الأَحْمَرَ في العَقَبَةِ.
dialogue.tr: li-narā nahra l-Urdunni wa l-baḥra l-aḥmara fī l-ʿAqaba
dialogue.en: To see the Jordan River and the Red Sea at Aqaba.
dialogue.ur: Taake hum Urdun ka darya aur Aqaba mein Bahr-e-Ahmar dekhein.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ رائِعَةٌ، أَنا مُوافِقٌ.
dialogue.tr: fikratun rāʾiʿa, anā muwāfiq
dialogue.en: A wonderful idea. I agree.
dialogue.ur: Bohat umda khayal hai, main mutafiq hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ نُسافِرُ؟ بِالجَوِّ أَوْ بِالبَحْرِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa kayfa nusāfir? bil-jawwi aw bil-baḥr?
dialogue.en: And how do we travel? By air or by sea?
dialogue.ur: Aur hum kaise safar karein? Hawa ke raaste ya samundar ke?

dialogue.ar: بِالجَوِّ أَسْرَعُ يا أُمّي.
dialogue.tr: bil-jawwi asraʿu yā ummī
dialogue.en: By air is faster, mother.
dialogue.ur: Hawai safar tez hota hai, ammi.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ تَذاكِرَ الطَّائِرَةِ غالِيَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: lākinna tadhākira ṭ-ṭāʾirati ghāliya
dialogue.en: But plane tickets are expensive.
dialogue.ur: Lekin jahaz ki ticketein mehngi hain.

dialogue.ar: الأَرْخَصُ أَنْ نُسافِرَ بِالبَحْرِ.
dialogue.tr: al-arkhaṣu an nusāfira bil-baḥr
dialogue.en: The cheaper way is to travel by sea.
dialogue.ur: Sab se sasta tareeqa samundar ke raaste safar karna hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكَمْ يَوْماً نَقْضي هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa kam yawman naqḍī hunāk?
dialogue.en: And how many days do we spend there?
dialogue.ur: Aur hum wahan kitne din guzarein?

dialogue.ar: خَمْسَةَ أَيّامٍ يا أُمّي.
dialogue.tr: khamsata ayyāmin yā ummī
dialogue.en: Five days, mother.
dialogue.ur: Paanch din, ammi.

dialogue.ar: حَسَناً، اِتَّفَقْنا! خَمْسَةُ أَيّامٍ، وَالسَّفَرُ يَوْمَ الخَميسِ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥasanan, ittafaqnā! khamsatu ayyām, wa s-safaru yawma l-khamīsi bi-idhni llāh
dialogue.en: Fine, agreed! Five days, and the trip is on Thursday, by Allah’s permission.
dialogue.ur: Theek hai, tay ho gaya! Paanch din, aur safar Jumeraat ko, Allah ke izn se.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا أُمّي.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā ummī
dialogue.en: Thank you, mother.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya ammi.

q.en: How does the mother describe plane tickets?
q.ur: Ammi jahaz ki ticketon ko kaisa batati hain?

q.en: What is cheaper, according to Sultan?
q.ur: Sultan ke mutabiq kya sasta hai?

q.en: How many days will they spend in Jordan?
q.ur: Woh Urdun mein kitne din guzarenge?

title.en: Dialogue 3: Where will you spend the holiday?

intro.en: A teacher asks five students where they will spend the summer holiday. Each one has a different plan. Notice the future with «سَـ» (sa-): سَأَقْضي means "I will spend".
intro.ur: Ustani paanch talba se poochti hain ke woh gharmiyon ki chhutti kahan guzarenge. Har ek ka mukhtalif mansooba hai. «سَـ» wala mustaqbil dhyan se dekhein: سَأَقْضي ka matlab "main guzaroonga".
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ المُعَلِّمَةُ خَمْسَةَ طُلّابٍ: أَيْنَ سَتَقْضونَ عُطْلَةَ الصَّيْفِ؟ لِكُلٍّ مِنْهُمْ خُطَّةٌ. لاحِظِ المُسْتَقْبَلَ بِـ«سَـ»: سَأَقْضي.

dialogue.ar: مَرْحَباً يا طُلّابُ، أَيْنَ سَتَقْضونَ العُطْلَةَ هَذا الصَّيْفَ؟
dialogue.tr: marḥaban yā ṭullāb, ayna sa-taqḍūna l-ʿuṭlata hādhā ṣ-ṣayf?
dialogue.en: Hello, students. Where will you spend the holiday this summer?
dialogue.ur: Khush amdeed talba, aap is gharmi mein chhutti kahan guzarenge?

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي العُطْلَةَ في المَزْرَعَةِ مَعَ جَدّي، وَسَأُساعِدُهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: saʾaqḍī l-ʿuṭlata fī l-mazraʿati maʿa jaddī, wa saʾusāʿiduhu kulla yawm
dialogue.en: I will spend the holiday on the farm with my grandfather, and I will help him every day.
dialogue.ur: Main chhutti dada ke saath khet par guzaroonga, aur har roz unki madad karunga.

dialogue.ar: سَأَزورُ المَتاحِفَ في العاصِمَةِ مَعَ خالَتي في هَذِهِ العُطْلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: saʾazūru l-matāḥifa fī l-ʿāṣimati maʿa khālatī fī hādhihi l-ʿuṭla
dialogue.en: I will visit the museums in the capital with my aunt in this holiday.
dialogue.ur: Main is chhutti mein khala ke saath daarul-hukumat ke museum dekhoongi.

dialogue.ar: سَأَذْهَبُ مَعَ فَريقِ الجَوّالَةِ إِلى الجِبالِ.
dialogue.tr: saʾadhhabu maʿa farīqi l-jawwāla ilā l-jibāl
dialogue.en: I will go with the scout team to the mountains.
dialogue.ur: Main scout team ke saath pahaadon par jaaunga.

dialogue.ar: سَأَذْهَبُ مَعَ أُسْرَتي إِلى مَكَّةَ لِلْعُمْرَةِ، ثُمَّ نَزورُ المَدينَةَ وَالمَسْجِدَ النَّبَوِيَّ.
dialogue.tr: saʾadhhabu maʿa usratī ilā Makka lil-ʿumra, thumma nazūru l-Madīnata wa l-masjida n-nabawiyy
dialogue.en: I will go with my family to Makkah for Umrah, then we will visit Madinah and the Prophet’s Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Main ghar walon ke saath Umrah ke liye Makkah jaoongi, phir hum Madinah aur Masjid-e-Nabawi jayenge.

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي العُطْلَةَ في بَلَدي، وَسَأَلْعَبُ مَعَ أَبْناءِ عَمّي.
dialogue.tr: saʾaqḍī l-ʿuṭlata fī baladī, wa saʾalʿabu maʿa abnāʾi ʿammī
dialogue.en: I will spend the holiday in my country, and I will play with my uncle's children.
dialogue.ur: Main chhutti apne mulk mein guzaroonga, aur chacha ke bachon ke saath khelunga.

dialogue.ar: عُطْلَةٌ سَعيدَةٌ يا طُلّابُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿuṭlatun saʿīda yā ṭullāb
dialogue.en: Happy holiday, students.
dialogue.ur: Chhutti mubarak ho, talba.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا مُعَلِّمَتَنا.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā muʿallimatanā
dialogue.en: Thank you, our teacher.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya hamari ustani.

q.en: Where will Maryam spend the holiday?
Khalid will go with the scouts to the...
q.ur: Khalid scouts ke saath kahan jayega?
q.ar: سَيَذْهَبُ خالِدٌ مَعَ فَريقِ الجَوّالَةِ إِلى...

q.en: Who will help his grandfather on the farm?
q.ur: Khet par apne dada ki madad kaun karega?

intro.en: Practice with the Arabic (Hijri) months: arrange them in order, and say which month comes before or after another. The months start with Muharram and end with Dhul-Hijjah.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Arabi (Hijri) mahinon ki mashq karte hain: unhein tarteeb se likhna aur yeh batana ke kaun sa mahina kis se pehle ya baad aata hai. Mahine Muharram se shuru aur Zil-Hijjah par khatam hote hain.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الشُّهورِ العَرَبِيَّةِ (الهِجْرِيَّةِ): رَتِّبْها، وَقُلْ أَيُّ شَهْرٍ قَبْلَ شَهْرٍ آخَرَ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ. تَبْدَأُ الشُّهورُ بِالمُحَرَّمِ وَتَنْتَهي بِذي الحِجَّةِ.

q.en: What is the first Arabic month?
q.ur: Pehla Arabi mahina kaun sa hai?

q.en: What is the last Arabic month?
q.ur: Aakhri Arabi mahina kaun sa hai?
Ramazan se pehle kaun sa mahina hai?

q.en: In which month do Muslims fast?
q.ur: Musalman kis mahine mein roza rakhte hain?

q.en: Eid al-Fitr is in the month of...

intro.en: Practice what you learned: answer questions about Eid, Zakat al-Fitr and the family trip, and match words to make expressions like «عيدُ الفِطْر» and «صَلاةُ العيد».
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum ne jo seekha uski mashq hai: Eid, Zakat-ul-Fitr aur ghar walon ke safar ke sawalon ke jawab dena, aur lafzon ko jod kar jumle banana jaise «عيدُ الفِطْر» aur «صَلاةُ العيد».
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى ما تَعَلَّمْتَ: أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ حَوْلَ العيدِ وَزَكاةِ الفِطْرِ وَرِحْلَةِ الأُسْرَةِ، وَطابِقِ الكَلِماتِ لِتُكَوِّنَ عِباراتٍ مِثْلَ «عيدُ الفِطْرِ» وَ«صَلاةُ العيدِ».

q.en: Complete: ____ الفِطْر (the festival of breaking the fast)

q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ هِيَ الصَّلاةُ الَّتي نُؤَدّيها يَوْمَ العيدِ؟
أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الإِجازَةِ في فَصْلِ الصَّيْفِ؟

intro.en: The letters of Arabic are two kinds. With «الـ», the moon letters keep the «ل» clear (القَمَر), but with the sun letters the «ل» is silent and the next letter is doubled (الشَّمْس). We also listen to a short text about summer holidays.
intro.ur: Arabi ke huroof do qism ke hain. «الـ» ke saath qamari huroof mein «ل» saaf parha jata hai (القَمَر), lekin shamsi huroof mein «ل» nahi parha jata aur agla harf dohra ho jata hai (الشَّمْس). Hum gharmiyon ki chhuttiyon par aik chhota matan bhi sunte hain.
intro.ar: حُروفُ العَرَبِيَّةِ مَعَ «الـ» نَوْعانِ: القَمَرِيَّةُ تَظْهَرُ فيها اللّامُ كَما في «القَمَر»، وَالشَّمْسِيَّةُ تَسْكُتُ فيها اللّامُ وَيُشَدَّدُ الحَرْفُ التّالي كَما في «الشَّمْس». ثُمَّ نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى نَصٍّ قَصيرٍ عَنْ عُطْلَةِ الصَّيْفِ.

q.en: Which word starts with a sun letter?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz shamsi harf se shuru hota hai?

q.en: Which word starts with a moon letter?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz qamari harf se shuru hota hai?

q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الحُروفِ شَمْسِيٌّ؟

title.ur: Guftagu: Aap kaise safar karte hain?

intro.en: Practice speaking with a partner: ask how your friend travels to a country (by plane, by ship, by car, by train) and answer using the same pattern.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum apne saathi ke saath guftagu ki mashq karte hain: poochhein ke woh kisi mulk tak kaise safar karta hai (jahaz, kashti, gaari, rail) aur usi andaz mein jawab dein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى الكَلامِ: اسْأَلْهُ كَيْفَ يُسافِرُ إِلى بَلَدٍ (بِالطّائِرَةِ، بِالسَّفينَةِ، بِالسَّيّارَةِ، بِالقِطارِ) وَأَجِبْ بِالتَّرْكيبِ نَفْسِهِ.

q.en: How do you ask "How do you travel to Egypt?"
q.ur: "Aap Misr kaise jate hain?" kaise poochhein?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ صَديقَكَ عَنْ طَريقَةِ سَفَرِهِ إِلى مِصْرَ؟
أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني وَسيلَةَ سَفَرٍ في الجَوِّ؟
أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني وَسيلَةً تَسيرُ عَلى السِّكَّةِ الحَديدِيَّةِ؟

q.ur: «كَمْ يَوْماً سَتَقْضي؟» kis ke baare mein hai?

intro.en: Read a passage about who will do what in the summer: Ahmad helps his father on the farm, Ali goes to Makkah and Madinah, and Umar travels to Egypt. Then answer questions about the text.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aik matan parhein ke gharmiyon mein kaun kya karega: Ahmad farm mein walid ki madad karega, Ali Makkah aur Madinah jaye ga, aur Umar Misr jaye ga. Phir matan ke sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ نَصًّا عَمَّنْ سَيَفْعَلُ ماذا في الصَّيْفِ: أَحْمَدُ يُساعِدُ أَباهُ في المَزْرَعَةِ، وَعَلِيٌّ يَذْهَبُ إِلى مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ، وَعُمَرُ يُسافِرُ إِلى مِصْرَ. ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ النَّصِّ.

q.en: Who will travel to Saudi Arabia?
Who will help his father on the farm?
q.ur: Farm mein walid ki madad kaun karega?
Umar ka khandaan kaise safar karega?

q.en: The student travelled to Egypt to study...
q.ur: Talib-ilm Misr mein kya parhne gaya?
q.ar: ماذا سافَرَ الطّالِبُ إِلى مِصْرَ لِيَدْرُسَ؟

intro.en: Review words and phrases from the unit: festivals, farm, mountains, rivers, seas and museums, and sentence patterns with «كَمْ», «أَيْنَ», «مَتى» and «لِماذا».
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum is unit ke alfaaz aur jumle dohrate hain: tehwaar, farm, pahad, darya, samundar aur museum, aur «كَمْ», «أَيْنَ», «مَتى» aur «لِماذا» wale jumle.
intro.ar: راجِعْ كَلِماتِ الوِحْدَةِ وَعِباراتِها: الأَعْيادُ، وَالمَزْرَعَةُ، وَالجِبالُ، وَالأَنْهارُ، وَالبِحارُ، وَالمَتاحِفُ، وَتَراكيبُ «كَمْ» وَ«أَيْنَ» وَ«مَتى» وَ«لِماذا».

vocab.ur: hum rishtedaron aur doston se milte hain

q.en: When is Eid al-Adha? (use the pattern «مَتى»)
q.ar: أَجِبْ عَنْ سُؤالِ «مَتى»: مَتى عيدُ الأَضْحى؟

options: في اليَوْمِ العاشِرِ مِنْ ذي الحِجَّة

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَكانًا تُعْرَضُ فيهِ الآثارُ القَديمَةُ؟

intro.en: A review test on the last two units: vocabulary, singular and plural, opposites, and short sentences.
intro.ur: Pichhle do unit ka jaiza: alfaaz, wahid aur jama, ulte alfaaz aur chhote jumle.
intro.ar: اخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ عَلى الوِحْدَتَيْنِ الأَخيرَتَيْنِ: المُفْرَداتُ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالجَمْعُ، وَالأَضْدادُ، وَالجُمَلُ القَصيرَةُ.

intro.en: The final exam for the whole of Book 1: listening and understanding, vocabulary, singular and plural, opposites, verbs, sentences and writing. Take your time. Well done on reaching the end of Book 1!
intro.ur: Pori Kitaab 1 ka aakhri imtihaan: sunna aur samajhna, alfaaz, wahid aur jama, ulte alfaaz, af'aal, jumle aur likhna. Aaram se karein. Kitaab 1 mukammal karne par mubarak ho!
intro.ar: الاخْتِبارُ النِّهائِيُّ لِلْكِتابِ الأَوَّلِ كُلِّهِ: الفَهْمُ وَالاسْتِماعُ، وَالمُفْرَداتُ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالجَمْعُ، وَالأَضْدادُ، وَالأَفْعالُ، وَالجُمَلُ، وَالكِتابَةُ. خُذْ وَقْتَكَ. أَحْسَنْتَ إِذْ وَصَلْتَ إِلى نِهايَةِ الكِتابِ الأَوَّلِ!

q.en: Which is a part of the body?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz jism ka hissa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ عُضْوٌ مِنْ أَعْضاءِ الجِسْمِ؟
